description: This PHP file defines the 'Header' class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System, specifically in the reporting module. The class manages report header columns and related metadata, providing methods for setting, retrieving, and normalizing header columns.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents a report header, managing a collection of columns (either Column or StackedColumn) and associated metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Header instance with an array of columns.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the list of columns in the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the columns for the header, adding each via addColumn.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a single column, validating its type.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header's columns to an array representation.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Gets the metadata associated with the header.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the metadata for the header.
